requiredFindings.title: SM-7 omits required NE manifest and chunk fields
requiredFindings.evidence: NE frame table:2876-2879 requires DependencySourceManifest {dependencySourceSetId, manifestSha256, entries} and DependencySourceChunk {dependencySourceSetId, packageKey, path, chunkIndex, byteOffset, bytes}. The sender constructs only {dependencySourceSetId, entries}, then sends raw file bytes in u32 frames. The receiver explicitly requires that two-key manifest and consumes unlabelled raw chunks positionally. Only the later seal supplies manifestSha256. The nine negative controls test the simplified stream, not missing/mismatched chunk identity/index/offset fields.
requiredFindings.impact: Order, content hashing and seal echo are present, but the requested NE order-and-fields shape is not. Timings omit required per-chunk metadata serialization/validation and manifest-digest handling. The JSON/no-CBOR/no-conformance disclosure does not account for those omitted semantic fields.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Implement a new retained variant that represents all required NE manifest/chunk/seal fields (JSON remains acceptable as the disclosed encoding), verifies set/package/path associations, contiguous chunk indexes and offsets and manifest digest, and adds corresponding positive/refusal controls. Preserve current r2 as simplified-stream history and collect the corrected shape’s measurements. Alternatively explicitly classify these timings as simplified transfer information with omitted fields and costs disclosed, remove the NE-shaped/D-2 measurement claim, and leave the required SM-7-shaped series owed. Do not upgrade the current measurements into protocol conformance.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Replace vague repository timing comparison with exact descriptive differences
